name: Hora dipterocarp
desc: A giant endemic rainforest tree, up to about 40 to 45 m tall, with winged seeds carried by wind. It grows in the wet lowlands including Sinharaja, where dipterocarps dominate the valleys and lower slopes.
about: Dipterocarpus zeylanicus, commonly known as හොර - Hora in Sinhalese and සරල - Sarala or කිරිපලු - Kiripalu, is a species of Dipterocarpus that is endemic to Sri Lanka.
